title: GTA 6 Story Length Leak: About 50 Hours, Report Claims
description: GTA 6 story length is reportedly around 50 hours with nearly 100 missions in five chapters, and Platinum may take 200 hours, per a new Insider Gaming leak.

body.text: The GTA 6 story length may be around 50 hours, according to a new leak reported by Game Rant. The claim comes from Insider Gaming's Tom Henderson, who also reportedly detailed the mission count and how long a Platinum run could take. Rockstar hasn't confirmed any of it, but with launch set for November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, players are already planning their time.
GTA 6 story length and mission count in the leak
Henderson's November 15 report says the game has nearly 100 story missions spread over five chapters. The campaign reportedly runs about 50 hours.

Rockstar has confirmed that the story plays out in chapters, following Jason and Lucia across the fictional state of Leonida. Major plot beats move the pair between different regions of the map. That mirrors Red Dead Redemption 2. The studio has not shared a chapter count, a mission count or an official length.

Game Rant stresses that the number could shift a lot, even for players who ignore side content. Rockstar has already said GTA 6 uses open-ended mission design, so some ways of finishing an objective may be much quicker than others.
How it compares with earlier GTA 6 leaks
Earlier chatter pointed higher. An August 2025 rumour claimed a 75-hour campaign, though that was never confirmed.

A firmer reference point came from The New York Times, which reported that Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson finished an approximately 80-hour playthrough in February 2026. According to the report, his run covered the main story plus some of the more significant optional objectives, which reportedly carry unspecified narrative consequences.
That doesn't make 80 hours the average. It does show that total playtime will depend heavily on how much optional content you chase.
The same leak puts the Platinum trophy, or the Xbox equivalent, at roughly 200 hours. That would sit close to Red Dead Redemption 2 as one of Rockstar's most time-consuming games to fully complete.

Game Rant notes this figure looks less certain than the campaign estimate. Randomisation mechanics could make some achievements unpredictable. One possible example is the 170 wildlife species Rockstar announced in September 2026, since finding them all is expected to be tied to at least one achievement. RDR2 had two comparable trophies, Skin Deep and Zoologist.

There's also a multiplayer angle. GTA 6 launches without multiplayer, as RDR2 did. When RDR2 Online arrived in November 2018, the game gained 17 multiplayer-specific achievements. If Rockstar follows that pattern, the time needed to platinum GTA 6 could grow after launch.

Treat the 50-hour and 200-hour figures as leaks until Rockstar says otherwise. The real answer arrives on November 19, when players can see how long the story takes in practice. Watch for official word on chapters and missions, early completion times from players, and any hint about post-launch multiplayer and the achievements that could come with it.

faqs.q: How long is the GTA 6 story?
faqs.a: According to a November 15 Insider Gaming report by Tom Henderson, cited by Game Rant, the main story takes about 50 hours. Rockstar has not confirmed this figure, and the real time could vary with how players approach missions.

faqs.q: How many missions and chapters does GTA 6 have?
faqs.a: The same leak claims nearly 100 story missions split across five chapters. Rockstar has confirmed a chapter-based structure but has not said how many chapters or missions there are.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get the GTA 6 Platinum trophy?
faqs.a: The report estimates around 200 hours for the Platinum trophy or its Xbox equivalent, roughly on par with Red Dead Redemption 2. This estimate is less certain than the campaign length because randomised mechanics could make some achievements unpredictable.

sources.title: GTA 6 Story Length, Achievement Details, and More Detailed in New Leak
